home.faqSubtitle: Everything you need to know before you start. Still curious? Talk to a human.
home.faq1Question: How long does it take to get started?
home.faq1Answer: Most teams are running their first workflow within an afternoon. Our guided setup imports your contacts, products and opening balances, and you can invite your team as you go.
home.faq2Question: Can I use only the modules I need?
home.faq2Answer: Yes. Start with sales, inventory or finance and add modules when you are ready. All modules share the same data, so you never have to migrate twice.
home.faq3Question: Does Swantara work for multiple companies?
home.faq3Answer: Scale is built for groups. Manage multiple entities, currencies and warehouses from one login while keeping each company's books separate.
home.faq4Answer: Your data is encrypted in transit and at rest. We run on hardened infrastructure with role-based access, audit logs and regular backups.

about.title:
We build calm software
for ambitious teams.
about.subtitle: Swantara started with a simple observation: most teams do not need more tools. They need fewer places to look.
about.storyP1: We spent years building operations for growing companies and watching the same pattern repeat. A promising business would outgrow its spreadsheets, add a tool for every team, and slowly lose the thread that connected it all.
about.storyP2: Swantara began as a shared record — one place where orders, stock, invoices and people could agree. That small idea grew into a complete operating system, designed to feel quiet even when the business is loud.
about.storyP3: Today, teams in 18 countries use Swantara to close their books, ship their products and take care of their people. We are still a small team, and we still believe software should make work feel lighter.
about.value1Description: The best interface is the one your team understands on the first try. We choose plain language and obvious next steps.
about.value2Description: Small things compound. A well-designed approval, a clear empty state and a fast page all add up to trust.
about.value3Description: We ship in small, useful increments and listen closely to the people doing the work.
about.value4Description: Your operating data is serious business. We treat security, privacy and reliability as product features.

A small team
with a long view.
